gloss: to paste together; to glue together

definitions.gloss: to paste together; to glue (two things) face to face
definitions.explanation: To join two sheets or pieces together by applying adhesive between them, so that their surfaces stick face to face. Common with paper, boards, photos, and layered materials.

examples.japanese: {紙|かみ}を{貼|は}り{合|あ}わせる。
examples.english: To paste sheets of paper together.

examples.japanese: {二枚|にまい}の{板|いた}をのりで{貼|は}り{合|あ}わせた。
examples.english: I glued the two boards together with adhesive.

examples.japanese: {薄|うす}い{木材|もくざい}を{何枚|なんまい}も{貼|は}り{合|あ}わせて、{丈夫|じょうぶ}な{板|いた}を{作|つく}る。
examples.english: Many thin sheets of wood are glued together to make a strong board.

notes:
Compound of {貼|は}る (to stick, paste) + {合|あ}わせる (to join together). The {合|あ}わせる component adds the sense of joining two things to each other.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Transitive ({他動詞|たどうし}).
- Pattern: AとBを{貼|は}り{合|あ}わせる / AをBに{貼|は}り{合|あ}わせる

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {紙|かみ}を{貼|は}り{合|あ}わせる: paste papers together
- のりで{貼|は}り{合|あ}わせる: glue together with paste
